documentTitle: EASA Private Pilot Studies -- Chapter 12 Communications

sections.notes: EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22390-22530: pilot-training background on radio discipline, concise transmissions, listening watch, frequency expression, 8.33 kHz capability wording, and primary-reference pointers. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22609-22650: pilot-training background on message parts, numeric pronunciation, decimal usage, altitude/flight-level/QNH expression, and heading expression. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22661-22752: pilot-training background on CAP 413 number-expression notes, phonetic-letter pronunciation, transmission technique, initial contact, callsign use, and ATIS code mention on first call. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22763-22775: pilot-training background on six-figure frequency transmission/readback and shortened frequency expression when the final figures are zero. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22776-22795: pilot-training background on Correction, Say Again, All Stations, multiple-station reply order, Confirm Squawk, and selected standard words from Break through Out. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22796-22803: pilot-training background on selected standard words from Acknowledge through Recleared. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22808-22842: pilot-training background on selected standard words from Report through Words Twice, UK Pass Your Message usage note, and stopping/runway-vacated wording. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22845-22852: pilot-training background on UTC/Zulu time expression and 24-hour clock interpretation. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22863-22867: pilot-training background on callsign abbreviation cautions and the station-callsign invitation-to-proceed convention. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22868-22899: pilot-training background on station/service suffixes, position-report item order, and ATC instruction compliance context. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22910-22940: pilot-training background on ATC/FIS/AGCS categories and pilot-side sequencing of ATIS, startup, taxi, tower, joining, circuit reports, and go-around calls. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22946-22990: pilot-training background on relayed frequency changes, ground/tower responsibilities, taxi clearance limits, circuit/final reporting, continue versus landing clearance, and go-around wording. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 22995-23049: pilot-training background on approach/radar roles, controlled-airspace entry, radar control/advisory/information service context, radar identification, vectoring, and area control. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23050-23060: pilot-training background on beginning transmissions with service-provider and aircraft callsigns, when readback is required, and terminating readbacks with the aircraft radio callsign. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23061-23082: pilot-training background on compliance with acknowledged clearances/instructions, clearance identification, amended-clearance requests, Unable To Comply, and mandatory readback item categories. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23083-23090: pilot-training background on route-clearance content and complete readback of a route-clearance example. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23101-23114: pilot-training background on key-element readbacks, takeoff/departure word restrictions, and cleared/cross/approved runway-movement wording limits. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23115-23124: pilot-training background on conditional-clearance dependency, identifying the aircraft or vehicle that causes the condition, and short-test-transmission principles. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23125-23138: pilot-training background on conditional-clearance sequence, condition-first readback, UK After/ICAO Behind note, and radio-check test-transmission format items. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23149-23179: pilot-training background on radio-check replies, unreadable-station response, readability scale, and transfer-of-communication examples. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23184-23222: pilot-training background on communications-failure checks, transmitting blind, last-clearance compliance, circuit light signals, receiver-failure reports, and transponder code context. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23227-23266: pilot-training background on distress/urgency initial frequency choice, first receiving station actions, radio silence, cancellation on original frequencies, message contents, fuel-emergency wording, and intercepted-distress actions. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23271-23312: pilot-training background on distress-call meaning, MAYDAY format, aircraft and position details, pilot-qualification context, and visual distress signals. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.

EPPLS Chapter 12 Communications lines 23317-23354: pilot-training background on MAYDAY cancellation format, urgency/PAN format, emergency frequencies, emergency squawk 7700, and ident use when unable to change squawk. Background support only; do not supersede ICAO, SERA, CAP 413, or H01.
